name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing frequent patch updates across multiple supported version branches. The latest release is v0.60.2 (Open Source) / v1.60.2 (Enterprise), released on April 22, 2025 (https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases/tag/v0.60.2). Multiple branches (v54, v55, v57, v58, v59, v60) are receiving concurrent patch maintenance, indicating a mature multi-version support policy. Detailed changelogs per release were not rendered in the provided changelog text, so specific feature changes per release are not available from this source.

answers.What is the current license?: Dual-licensed: Open Source edition under AGPL v3; Enterprise edition under a commercial license
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple patch releases across several version branches as recently as April 22, 2025
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed cloud) is available at metabase.com
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, MongoDB, Oracle, Druid, Presto/Trino, SparkSQL, and more via drivers; full list at metabase.com/docs

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers more powerful and polished data visualization capabilities but is proprietary, significantly more expensive, and does not offer a self-hosted open-source option.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash integrates natively with dbt for a metrics-layer-first approach, making it ideal for dbt users, but it has a smaller ecosystem and fewer data source connectors than Metabase.
